name: Alabama
overview: Alabama provides homestead exemptions, including additional age, disability and blindness provisions.

programs.name: Homestead exemptions
programs.ageRule: General homestead relief; additional exemptions for age 65+, disability, or blindness.
programs.incomeDefinition: Additional relief uses state adjusted gross income or combined federal taxable income, depending on exemption.
programs.incomeLimits: Several additional exemptions use a $12,000 income limit; disability rules differ.
programs.maximumBenefit: Exempt assessed value or the full qualifying tax bill, depending on exemption.
programs.formulaSummary: Reduces taxable assessed value or exempts specified state/county levies.
programs.application: Apply to the local county taxing official.
eligibilityNotes: Owner-occupied principal residence; acreage limits apply.
County and municipal relief can differ.
